text: 🎬 Sally Field wins the Emmy. At 79. Every bit earned. Sally Field took home Outstanding Lead Actress for Netflix's Remarkably Bright Creatures , becoming the oldest winner in her category. It looks like cozy background streaming. It isn't. Director Olivia Newman built something genuinely warm and well-crafted, and Field carries it with a precision that makes you forget she's acting at all. Two Oscars and a near-mythic ability to make good material feel true. Netflix handed her a solid script, and she handed Netflix a masterclass. ✈️ Add to watchlist
